device.basis: Still development engine of X-T20 2.11 (step marker 0x06023320): started by a command in +0x04 bits 0..2 that 0x1561158 takes from its descriptor's first byte: a still runs 1 then 7, the develop-RAW service (USB RAW CONV., 0x1618d94) 1 then 6, and 0x1560e1c writes 2 between jobs, so bit 0 or bit 2 starts a job (xpro-lab emulator trace 2026-11-15); a run raises interrupt 130 until the handler 0x1560744 stops the engine with +0x00 bit 0. run ticks are xpro-lab's 3 ms engine step; no data moves.
